figure_table_trace.caption_claim: System description: Bi-Level PEPA components mapped to AIDE\textsuperscript{2}.
supported_manuscript_claims: We instantiate Bi-Level PEPA on AIDE\textsuperscript{2} as the primary specimen. The instantiation is evidence-anchored: every component of our framework ties to either a publicly disclosed element of AIDE protocol or an audit finding from our source-code review.
limitations: We have not validated Bi-Level PEPA on any system other than AIDE\textsuperscript{2}. Cross-system validation on RL-based prompt search or AutoML-Zero extensions is open future work.
